name: Billing Report Request V 01
definition: The BillingReportRequest message is sent by the system member to the system transaction administrator to request cumulative or itemised billing data. The billing data may be cumulative information or aggregated information on the level of a single securities or a dedicated cash account within a given period for each service item.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Defines the characteristics specific to the message, such as the identification or the creation date and time.

SearchCriteria.name: Search Criteria
SearchCriteria.definition: Defines the criteria to be used to extract the billing data.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
